const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers
  const getInfo = (obj) =>
    new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      obj.getInfo((res, err) => {
        if (err) reject(err);
        else resolve(res);
      });
    });

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const roi = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [
      [-67.5, 17.8],
      [-65.0, 17.8],
      [-65.0, 18.6],
      [-67.5, 18.6],
      [-67.5, 17.8],
    ],
  ]);
  const dates = ['2016-09-21', '2016-09-22'];
  const scale = 1000;

  // 2. Data Acquisition & Helper to get daily image (with fallback)
  async function getDailyImage(dateStr) {
    const start = ee.Date(dateStr);
    const end = start.advance(1, 'day');

    const sources = [
      { id: 'NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A2', band: 'DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL', label: 'VNP46A2' },
      { id: 'NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A1', band: 'DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m', label: 'VNP46A1' },
    ];

    for (let s of sources) {
      try {
        const col = ee.ImageCollection(s.id)
          .filterBounds(roi)
          .filterDate(start, end);
        const size = await getInfo(col.size());
        if (size > 0) {
          const img = col.mosaic().select([s.band]).clip(roi);
          return { img, band: s.band, src: s.label, count: size };
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // Dataset or band error; try next source
      }
    }
    return { img: null, band: null, src: null, count: 0 };
  }

  function isInvalidNumber(x) {
    return x === null || x === undefined || Number.isNaN(x) || !Number.isFinite(x);
  }

  try {
    // Total pixel count baseline at the chosen scale
    const totalCount = await getInfo(
      ee.Image(1)
        .rename('one')
        .reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: roi,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e9,
        })
        .get('one')
    );

    const results = [];
    for (let d of dates) {
      const day = await getDailyImage(d);
      if (!day.img) {
        console.log(`${d}: images=0`);
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }

      const countsDict = await getInfo(
        day.img.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.mean(), sharedInputs: true }),
          geometry: roi,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e9,
        })
      );

      const validCount = countsDict[`${day.band}_count`];
      const meanVal = countsDict[`${day.band}_mean`];

      if (!validCount || validCount === 0) {
        console.log(`${d}: images=${day.count}, valid_px=0/${totalCount} (0.0%), src=${day.src}`);
        console.log('C2');
        return;
      }
      if (isInvalidNumber(meanVal)) {
        console.log(`${d}: images=${day.count}, invalid mean, src=${day.src}`);
        console.log('C3');
        return;
      }

      const coverage = (100 * validCount) / totalCount;
      console.log(
        `${d}: images=${day.count}, valid_px=${validCount}/${totalCount} (${coverage.toFixed(
          1
        )}%), mean=${meanVal.toFixed(4)}, src=${day.src}`
      );
      results.push({ date: d, mean: meanVal, validCount, src: day.src });
    }

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    const m21 = results[0].mean;
    const m22 = results[1].mean;
    const delta = m22 - m21;
    console.log(`Delta (22 - 21) = ${delta.toFixed(6)}`);

    if (isInvalidNumber(m21) || isInvalidNumber(m22)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    if (delta < 0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
